FQCOMBAT.DebugSettingHint: Writes the module's debug messages to the browser console. Off by default.
FQCOMBAT.DeathSaveSettingHint: When a character at 0 hit points starts their turn, the death saving throw is rolled automatically: three successes bring them back to 1 hit point, three failures kill them and remove them from combat, otherwise their turn is skipped. A minion at 0 hit points vanishes (token removed from combat and from the scene); an NPC at 0 hit points leaves the combat, its token staying on the scene.
FQCOMBAT.GMMustBeConnected: GM Must Be Connected for FQCardEngine module
FQCOMBAT.RollInitiativeSettingHint: Roll Normal Initiative In start combat and cards creating minions
